WVP-SIZE-001.requirement: Whenever an export profile configures a target or hard byte limit, each generated output must be measured after processing and satisfy that profile policy; the WhatsApp preset retains its qualified 9.5 MB target and 10 MB hard limit.

WVP-RUST-001.requirement: Repository-owned executable code, tests, and build tooling are Rust-only.

WVP-CONT-001.requirement: Persist progress after every meaningful state transition and recover UNKNOWN outcomes before retry.

WVP-RUST-002.requirement: Workflow YAML is declarative orchestration only; repository-owned build and validation logic remains Rust.

WVP-SUPPLY-001.requirement: Rust dependency policy is enforced with pinned cargo-deny across actual Windows and macOS targets.

WVP-ATTEST-001.requirement: Main-only provenance and SBOM attestations use full-SHA-pinned actions/attest v4; unsupported private-plan capability is classified, never faked.
